compute.rule: sum of the per-stage worker timings of every final and provisional, divided by the seconds of audio streamed (speech plus tails)

notes: video: the client decodes the mp4 frames and jpeg-encodes them in this process, so cpu and rss include that work
video: worker_compute_s keeps its rule (the worker's stage timings); the vision thread's time is vision.video.vision_frame_ms_mean per processed frame
service, replay client and monitor run in one process on this host; rss and cpu include all three
service_total_ms is the service-side latency: endpoint frame arrival (t_service_recv_ns) to the final's emission
client_ms is the monitor's arrival time minus the capture time of the endpoint frame, valid because both run here
response_ms is from the endpoint frame arrival to the response's emission
proxy clips are piper tts: latencies are real, emotion labels are not a result

a final is attributed to the clip whose span holds its t_media_end (the time the speech stopped). a span runs from the clip's start to the next clip's start, so it includes the silence after the clip. the segment start carries the vad pre-roll and is not used

le15s.description: 8 s to the 15 s cap (99.7 % cumulative)

provisionals.rule: median media-time gap between consecutive full-window provisionals within 1.0 +- 0.1 s
